module_title: SMC Sub-Components, SDP Timelines & Financial Accountability
introduction: This intermediate tier explores the precise breakdown of the non-parent SMC members, the exact timeline and structure of the School Development Plan, and the role of the SMC in financial transparency.

core_concepts.title: Breakdown of the 25% Non-Parent Members
core_concepts.description:
If 75% of the SMC consists of parents, who makes up the remaining 25%? The RTE rules divide this 25% into three equal sub-categories:
1. One-third (1/3): Elected members of the local authority (e.g., Panchayat member, Ward Councilor).
2. One-third (1/3): Teachers from the school (decided by the teachers themselves).
3. One-third (1/3): Local educationists or children from the school (often the Head Boy/Girl).

core_concepts.title: Structure of the School Development Plan (SDP)
core_concepts.description:
The SDP is not just a casual wish list; it has a rigid temporal structure prescribed by the RTE Rules:
- Perspective Plan: It must be a **3-Year Plan**.
- Annual Sub-Plans: This 3-year plan must be broken down into three distinct **Annual Sub-Plans**.
- Contents: It must calculate the class-wise enrollment estimates, calculate the number of additional teachers required (based on the 30:1 Pupil-Teacher Ratio), and estimate the financial requirement for infrastructure (buildings, toilets, drinking water).

core_concepts.title: Tenure and Meetings of the SMC
core_concepts.description:
- Tenure: The SMC must be reconstituted every **two years** to ensure that the committee consists of parents whose children are *currently* enrolled in the school.
- Meetings: The SMC must meet at least once a month. The minutes and decisions of the meetings must be made public and accessible to all parents.

core_concepts.title: Monitoring Mid-Day Meals (MDM)
core_concepts.description: A crucial application of the SMC is monitoring the PM POSHAN (formerly Mid-Day Meal) scheme. The SMC ensures that the food served meets nutritional norms, hygiene is maintained, and there is no caste-based discrimination during the serving of meals.

important_entities.name: Head Teacher (Principal)
important_entities.key_fact: The Ex-Officio Member-Convener of the SMC.
important_entities.significance: The Principal/Head Teacher does not chair the SMC (the Chairperson is always elected from among the parent members). The Principal acts as the Member-Convener, responsible for calling the meetings, keeping the records, and executing the decisions.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Many candidates assume the Principal is the head of the SMC. This is a fatal error in exams. To ensure true democratic decentralization, the **Chairperson and Vice-Chairperson MUST be elected from the 75% parent/guardian members**. The Principal is only the convener.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Link the SDP to the number 3. It's a 3-year master plan broken into 3 yearly action plans.

exam_strategy_tips: If a DSSSB question asks 'What is the tenure of a School Management Committee before it must be reconstituted?', the correct answer is **2 Years**.
